answers.violence: Yes — fantasy/cartoon wrecks and raids. No realistic gore, no torture.
answers.blood: Yes — implied, dried-blood palette, not realistic dismemberment.
answers.sexual_content: Suggestive themes only: attractive armored adult women in combat gear. No nudity, no sexual acts, no explicit content.
answers.gambling: No. Idle numbers are not real-money gambling.
answers.user_interaction: No. Single player. No chat, no UGC, no social.
answers.digital_purchases: Yes. One-time in-app purchases through Google Play Billing: each hero $0.99, all 20 heroes for $9.99, Double Tithe (permanent 2x resources) $2.99. No loot boxes, no random paid items, no subscriptions.
answers.unrestricted_internet: No in-app browsing. Two outbound links open the phone's own browser: NYX ON SPOTIFY (her catalog) and NYX WEBSITE (her site, only when set). Plus the game's own privacy, terms, and support pages.
answers.age_target: Adults. Not designed for children under 13; M/17+ presentation.
